content.title: Rockwell Automation to Build Plant in Wisconsin in $2 Billion Bet
content.summary: Rockwell Automation plans to build a plant near its headquarters in Milwaukee as the factory-automation company expands the capabilities of its equipment and software with generative artificial intelligence.  Rockwell said the new plant, at more than 1 million square feet, will be the company’s largest production and warehouse site.  Rockwell makes motor controls for factory machinery, sensors, data gathering devices, analytics software and other products that monitor and guide factory processes.
